generation.scope: With no surface projection, each forward branch center gives a unique finite chain of birational rational curves ending at a backward branch center, bijectively in a four-period window. Every successor on its birth line has that center as unique predecessor. The Pluecker degrees give exact zeroth and first moment identities for forward and backward defects; in particular any branching forces a periodic point sequence passing through a forward center.

open_mathematics: Analyze periodic point sequences with one-sided branching and their tangent and homological obstructions; complete the unresolved finite point strata and orbit structure.
